title: McLaren releases behind-the-scenes look at Lando Norris's hypercar test
extract: McLaren has released footage of Lando Norris completing 38 laps and 177km in the 2027 MCL-HY hypercar during a Portugal test, as the Woking team prepares for its World Endurance Championship programme.

title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
extract: Formula 1 has agreed in principle to reduce standard Grand Prix distance from 305km to 290km for 2027 as the sport prepares for revised power units with more combustion-engine output and less electrical power.

title: Red Bull admits Max Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027
extract: Red Bull says a persistent problem with Max Verstappen's 2026 car cannot be completely resolved until the next rules cycle, highlighting the technical compromises behind the current design.

title: Sebastian Vettel: F1 must combine 'things we love' with sustainable future
extract: Sebastian Vettel has argued that Formula 1's future should retain the elements enthusiasts value while adapting its technical and sporting direction for greater sustainability.

title: David Coulthard warns unchanged Madring return in 2027 would be 'stupidity'
extract: David Coulthard has called for changes to Madrid's new Madring circuit before Formula 1 returns in 2027, focusing attention on the track's overtaking characteristics.

title: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match
extract: Mercedes and Aston Martin teams took part in a charity football match, bringing two Formula 1-linked manufacturers together away from the circuit.

title: DeepSeek to brief UN Security Council on AI this week, sources say
extract: DeepSeek is expected to brief the UN Security Council on artificial intelligence risks, alongside representatives from major AI companies, as governments discuss AI and international security.

title: Belgium's Aikido launches cybersecurity AI model
extract: Belgian cybersecurity company Aikido has released an open-weight AI model designed for local cybersecurity deployments, allowing organisations to use defensive AI without sending sensitive code to external providers.

title: Canonical announces Zephyr 26.04 LTS for MCU-grade devices
extract: Canonical announced an enterprise Zephyr 26.04 LTS distribution with long-term support and device management for microcontroller products, building on the upstream real-time operating system.

title: European Quantum Software Stack for Quantum Computers
extract: The Q-VERSE project is developing a European, hardware-independent quantum software stack based around the open-source Eclipse Qrisp framework, aiming to make quantum application development more interoperable.

title: Alibaba unveils new AI chip and ambitious model plans
extract: Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 AI chip and plans for a much larger next-generation AI model, alongside an expansion of its cloud computing infrastructure.

title: FuseSoC turns 15 as open-source silicon development continues to grow
extract: The FOSSi Foundation marked the 15th anniversary of FuseSoC, the modular package manager and build-tool collection used in open-source hardware and systems-on-chip development.

title: Amix: Amiga Unix gets 68040/68060 support
extract: A new Amiga Unix kernel and patch allow the historic Amix System V port, previously limited to 68020 and 68030 processors, to run on 68040 and 68060 CPUs.

title: Real-time strategy: StarCraft port AmiSC 0.7.1
extract: AmiSC is an Amiga 68k native port of StarCraft that now includes a computer opponent and improved 320x240 and 640x480 modes while running directly on AmigaOS 3.x.

title: Puzzle game Connect 1.6 update improves 512 KB Amiga support
extract: Connect 1.6 fixes a crash affecting 512 KB Amigas when the second music track was loaded, allowing both tracks to work on the machine while also improving board-generation performance.

title: Copper Showdown Editor 0.5.0 adds new Amiga live-coding capabilities
extract: Copper Showdown Editor creates Amiga Copper lists in Lua and renders them through the vAmiga emulator; version 0.5.0 updates dependencies, the editor and audio handling.

title: Buzzard by Inez Ray arrives as a dystopian science-fiction novel
extract: Inez Ray's Buzzard is a dystopian science-fiction novel set in 2086, following a midwife imprisoned in a corporate-run facility who uncovers a disturbing mystery.

title: The Portal sends a retired FBI agent into an alternate universe
extract: J.J. Faggiana's new science-fiction thriller The Portal follows a retired FBI agent given the ability to travel backward through time into an alternate universe, where he confronts the consequences of intervention.

title: Fold Catastrophes collects new science fiction from Peter Watts
extract: Peter Watts's Fold Catastrophes is a new science-fiction short-story collection exploring brain-computer interfaces, life inside stars, behavioural hacking and ecological collapse.

title: Mick Herron on Slow Horses and Jackson Lamb
extract: Mick Herron discusses the return of Slow Horses, the evolution of Gary Oldman's Jackson Lamb compared with the character in the novels, and the continuing Slough House universe.

title: Both Online And Offline: H. Moser & Cie. Off-Grid
extract: H. Moser & Cie. has introduced the Off-Grid, a digital-mechanical hybrid with a skeletonized dial, a six-o'clock display and a D10 calibre developed with Sequent.

title: Bianchet Tonneau UltraFino Ceramic Skeleton
extract: Bianchet's Tonneau UltraFino Ceramic Skeleton uses the golden ratio and Fibonacci sequence as design principles for its proportions and flowing case architecture.

title: Apiar Carbon1.0 OG uses additively manufactured carbon fibre
extract: British independent Apiar has launched the Carbon1.0 OG, combining a CBAM carbon-fibre case structure with Grade 23 titanium and a lightweight sports-watch design.

title: Bucherer UK sales rise to £109 million and profits triple
extract: Rolex-owned Bucherer reported £109.2 million in UK sales and £3.5 million operating profit for its latest financial year, with its London retail presence increasingly centred on Covent Garden.

title: Norqain expands UK footprint through Watches of Switzerland Group
extract: Norqain is expanding its UK and Ireland distribution through new partnerships with Watches of Switzerland Group stores and online platforms.

title: Chronography aims to fill a gap in Ireland's watch event calendar
extract: A new Dublin horology event called Chronography will bring independent and microbrand watchmakers together for a one-day showcase at Smock Alley Theatre in October.

title: Star Trek: The Original Series gets a 60th-anniversary release
extract: Star Trek: The Original Series is receiving a 60th-anniversary DVD and Blu-ray release, marking a new home-media edition of the original series.

title: Resident Evil tops UK-Ireland box office with franchise-record opening
extract: The latest Resident Evil film opened to £4.2 million across the UK and Ireland, giving the long-running horror franchise its biggest regional opening to date.

title: Ash unearths long-lost track 'Bittersweet Blue' from the 1977 era
extract: Ash have released the previously unreleased Bittersweet Blue from the era of their debut album 1977, alongside the band's plans for a 30th-anniversary edition.

title: Bad Company announce previously unreleased Live in London album
extract: Bad Company will release Live in London, a previously unreleased 2016 concert recording, across vinyl, CD and digital formats in November.

title: Declan Welsh and The Decadent West announce Explicit Agitation
extract: Declan Welsh and The Decadent West have announced their new album Explicit Agitation for February 2027, accompanied by the single Run Down Small Town and a UK and European tour.

title: Sari Schorr releases Running Wild ahead of new album and tour
extract: Sari Schorr has released the title track from her forthcoming album Running Wild, ahead of a 46-date European tour beginning in London later this month.

title: Daley releases new album Strange Nature
extract: R&B and soul singer-songwriter Daley has released his new album Strange Nature, alongside the start of a 27-city US tour.

title: Tinashe on her new album Popstar
extract: Tinashe discusses her new album Popstar, her creative process and her interest in challenging expectations in a detailed cover-story interview.

title: Classic Rock Tracks Of The Week: September 21, 2026
extract: Louder's latest selection highlights new tracks from Greta Van Fleet, Royal Blood, Dirty Honey, The Pineapple Thief and other contemporary rock artists.
